enter.$description: Use for avatar group enter transitions.

exit.$description: Use for avatar group exit transitions.

hovered.$description: Use for hover state on avatar elements.
Use for button hover state transitions.

pressed.$description: Use for button pressed state transitions.

instant.$description: Use for instant feedback with no perceptible delay, such as list item hover, selected and focus states.

long.$description: Use for medium entrance transitions, such as modal enter and flag enter.

medium.$description: Use for medium exit transitions, such as modal exit and flag exit.

short.$description: Use for interactive state emphasis and small entrances, such as button hover and pressed states, popup enter, and avatar appear.

xlong.$description: Use for large transitions, such as panel enter/exit, page transitions, and full-screen overlays.

xshort.$description: Use for subtle pressed states and quick exits, such as component press feedback, popup dismiss, and avatar transitions.

xxlong.$description: Use for large transitions, such as onboarding steps and full-screen overlays.

xxshort.$description: Use for instant feedback, such as list item hover, selected and focus states.

practical.$description: Starts slowly and accelerates away. Best for exit transitions where elements leaving the screen should feel like they are getting out of the way.

bold.$description: The bold in-out curve pairs naturally with scale and repositioning of elements. It controls both the start and end of the motion.
Elements arrive quickly and decelerate to a stop. The fast start grabs attention and the gentle landing feels controlled.

practical.$description: A practical, everyday enter curve. Less dramatic than the bold variant, good for subtle transitions like content swaps, tab changes, and list reordering.

spring.$description: A spring curve that overshoots slightly before settling. Use for playful, tactile feedback on small branded elements such as avatar hover, where the slight overshoot reinforces a sense of life.

enter.$description: Use when a form message enters.

exit.$description: Use when a form message exits.

default.$description: Use for input hover, focus, and error state transitions.

selection.$description: Use for checkbox and radio surface, border and indicator state cross-fades.

toggle.$description: Use for toggle track colour, handle slide and icon transitions.

in.$description: Use for fade-in transitions where an element goes from fully transparent to fully opaque.

out.$description: Use for fade-out transitions where an element goes from fully opaque to fully transparent.

in.$description: Use to expand an inline grid column from 80% to full size on enter.

out.$description: Use to collapse an inline grid column from full size to zero on exit.

medium.$description: Use for medium scale-in transitions where an element grows from 80% to full size on enter.

small.$description: Use for small scale-in transitions where an element grows from 95% to full size on enter.

medium.$description: Use for medium scale-out transitions where an element shrinks from full size to 80% on exit.

small.$description: Use for small scale-out transitions where an element shrinks from full size to 95% on exit.

short.$description: Use for short slide-in transitions where an element enters from below its final position by 8px.

half.$description: Use for slide-in transitions where an element enters from the left of its final position by 50%.

short.$description: Use for short slide-in transitions where an element enters from the left of its final position by 8px.
Use for short slide-in transitions where an element enters from the right of its final position by 8px.
Use for short slide-in transitions where an element enters from above its final position by 8px.
Use for short slide-out transitions where an element exits downward by 8px from its starting position.

half.$description: Use for slide-out transitions where an element exits to the left of its starting position by 15%.

short.$description: Use for short slide-out transitions where an element exits to the left by 8px from its starting position.
Use for short slide-out transitions where an element exits to the right by 8px from its starting position.
Use for short slide-out transitions where an element exits upward by 8px from its starting position.

exit.$description: Use for label exit transitions (e.g. tag component).

hovered.$description: Use for list item hover state transitions.

pressed.$description: Use for list item pressed state transitions.

selected.$description: Use for list item selected state transitions.

right.$description: Use for panel enter from the right.

left.$description: Use for panel exit towards the left.

right.$description: Use for panel exit towards the right.

bottom.$description: Use for popup enter from the bottom.

left.$description: Use for popup enter from the left.

right.$description: Use for popup enter from the right.

top.$description: Use for popup enter from the top: popup, tooltip, dropdown, inline message, inline dialog.
